title: Aromatic Spice
summary: Toast whole spices, bloom ground spices in fat — fat carries volatile aromatics.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — aromatic spice is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: whole_spice, fat, heat. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Yogurt, coconut milk, or tomato cools and carries spice evenly.
